title: Morphisms of schemes glue along an open cover
statement: Let $X,Z$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $X=\bigcup_{i\in I}U_i$ an open covering. Given morphisms $f_i:U_i\to Z$ with $f_i|_{U_i\cap U_j}=f_j|_{U_i\cap U_j}$ for all $i,j$, there is a unique morphism $f:X\to Z$ with $f|_{U_i}=f_i$ for all $i$. In particular two morphisms $X\to Z$ whose restrictions to every $U_i$ agree are equal.

source.place: Schemes, Section 26.14 (Tag 01JA, glueing schemes; the morphisms $g_i$ glue as in the proof of Lemma 26.15.4, Tag 01JJ) together with Sheaves, Lemma 6.33.1 (Tag 04TN, glueing maps of sheaves) and Tag 00AN (label lemma-mapping-property-glue)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line: for the open cover by the U_i (pullback of two open immersions = intersection), `glueMorphisms` gives f, `ι_glueMorphisms` (line 471) gives f|U_i = f_i, and `Scheme.Cover.hom_ext` (line 460) gives uniqueness
